subject: GetYourGuide day tours that include Oxford, grouped by what the day covers
source: data/day-trips/gyg-inventory.json (destinations.Oxford, 31 London-departure product ids) plus the Blenheim Palace bucket and the Oxford-departure walking tours found on the product pages' own recommendation rails. Pages opened in the browser pane at https://www.getyourguide.com/en-gb/activity/-t<id>; curl 403s after a couple of requests.
method: Twelve product pages read on 12 September 2026. Inclusions and exclusions were taken from the DOM rows (inclusion-N-horizontal-1-title-text) and classified by the tick or cross icon on the same row, not by the title or by reading order, so a line reading 'Entry to X (if option selected)' is recorded as conditional even though it sits in the INCLUDES list. Prices are each page's own live adult 'from' price, which on several products differs from the cached SEO title and from the inventory figure. Findings for 71373, 18405, 234277, 60796, 1345509 and 2095's group context are reused from the sibling passes in stonehenge-tours.json, windsor-tours.json and bath-tours.json rather than re-read.

doorPriceBaseline.trainFromLondon: GBP 37.70 Off-Peak return from either London terminus; Advance singles from GBP 18 Paddington, GBP 15 Marylebone
doorPriceBaseline.oxfordTubeCoach: GBP 28 adult return, 24 hours a day, no last coach
doorPriceBaseline.christChurch: GBP 22.95 adult on a Michaelmas term weekday, GBP 2 less booked ahead

conditionalEntryPattern: The same trap as the Stonehenge, Bath and Windsor passes. The attraction is in the title and the inclusions row reads 'if selected' or 'if option selected', so the headline price is the option WITHOUT the ticket. On the Oxford set it hits Warwick Castle, Shakespeare's Birthplace, Christ Church, King's College Cambridge, Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Blenheim Palace.

groups.group: Oxford alone, or Oxford with a walking tour
groups.verdict: No London coach product goes to Oxford and nowhere else at a coach price. The one London-departure Oxford-only product is a GBP 150 guided day with three entries genuinely included. Cheaper and better value: take the train or the Oxford Tube and buy a walking tour in Oxford.

groups.group: Bought in Oxford after your own train - walking tours with college entry
groups.verdict: The honest answer for anyone who only wants Oxford. All three include real entry, all start in Oxford, and they add to a GBP 28 coach or GBP 37.70 train rather than replacing it.
